$comment: contracts/shared-types.json | version: 1 | owner: contracts-architect | spec_ref: LinkSnip URL shortener (AC-1..AC-16). JSON Schema mirror of shared-types.ts. Every example in `examples` MUST validate against its own schema.

LinkCode.description: System-generated short code; URL-safe alphanumeric, non-empty. Length/charset detail left to api-architect (A-1).

AbsoluteUrl.description: Absolute http/https URL, validated with the WHATWG URL parser; non-http(s) schemes rejected.

Link.description: Canonical link record exposed by the API.

LinkStats.description: Stats for a single link; identical shape to Link.

CreateLinkResponse.description: 201 response body for POST /api/links. shortUrl origin derives from request Host (A-3); a new code is minted per call even for duplicate URLs (A-4).

ApiErrorCode.description: Closed set of stable error codes; keep in sync with error-codes.md.

ApiError.description: Canonical error envelope for every non-2xx/3xx API response.

message.description: Optional human-readable detail; do not parse.

examples.message: url must be an absolute http or https URL
